description: Penyempurnaan HD ilustrasi hero SATU dengan margin transparan lebih rapat.
method: imagegen bawaan, penyempurnaan dari master ilustrasi yang disetujui
resolution_note: Tool menghasilkan 1392x1130 piksel asli. Tidak dilakukan upscale untuk menyamakan ukuran dengan target prompt.
alt_purpose: Dekoratif, alt kosong. Konten serta kontrol tersedia sebagai HTML.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied transparent SATU hero illustration. Primary request: make a high-definition, high-resolution version of this SAME illustration, target 2560 x 2080 pixels (at least 2048 pixels wide). Preserve the existing artwork exactly: same bird identity, facial expression, waving wing, proportions, cobalt blue and ivory feathers, orange markings, graphite beak, book bag, all four white concept cards, their precise placement and Indonesian text, cap, paper plane, purple teamwork tile, heart tile, sparkles, flowing light ribbons and platform. Change only rendering resolution/detail and transparent framing. Sharpen feather detail, bag texture and text edges naturally without changing the design. Exact text: 'Proyek kampus', 'Bangun portofolio', 'Berkarya bersama', 'Kembangkan kemampuan'. Keep the entire illustration intact. Reduce unnecessary fully transparent top and bottom padding so the overall artwork fills about 94% of the canvas, with modest clear space on every side. Use a wider landscape framing suited to the existing composition. Genuine transparent alpha background, preserve translucent blue ribbons and soft shadows, no solid background, no cropped sparkles, no missing or added objects, no new UI, no logo. This is a fidelity-preserving HD enhancement of an approved website asset, not a new design. Deliver a visibly higher resolution image with crisp refined detail and at least 2048-pixel width.
